_comment: D29 QUERY-STRING IDOR — REAL (must CONFIRM). Drives the query_target lab (GET /reports?report_id=). The attacker reads their OWN report_id=7 on the baseline; the attack swaps only the query id to the victim's 6. Tokens come from ENV ONLY (TARGET_ATTACKER_TOKEN=Bearer alice-query-token-aaaa, TARGET_OWNER_TOKEN=Bearer bob-query-token-bbbb). Boot the lab first: python -m uvicorn query_target.main:app --port 8003. Run: python run.py run --config examples/run.query_real.json
